description: Needs enableSupervisedControl and an integrated or dedicated server. Run one server command whose first word is in supervisedCommands in mcpfabric.config.json (time and weather by default); see supervised_status for the list. Command data ({...}) is refused. Answers with outcome applied or not_applied and the command output; uncertain if the server did not answer in time.

command.description: The command without or with a leading slash, e.g. "time set day".

name: supervised_command
title: Supervised command
